blocks.text: Gravitational waves Einstein ki general theory of relativity ki prediction hain, jo observations (mushahidaat) se sabit ho chuki hai, aur universe (kaainat) ke sab se extreme (shadeed) events ko dekhne ka naya darwaza khol rahi hain.

Einstein ki general theory of relativity ke mutabiq gravity koi force nahi balke massive bodies (bhaari ajsaam) ki wajah se spacetime ka curvature (mur jana) hai. Gravity gadde (mattress) mein bane gaddhe jaisi hai: bhaari cheezein apne ird-gird space ko mor deti (warp karti) hain, isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain. (Kitab mein “wrap” chhapa hai; matlab warp, yani morna.)

Gravitational waves ki prediction Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein ki thi. Yeh spacetime ki waves pehli baar 2015 mein detect hui, jab scientists ne is qism ke pehle observation ka announcement (elaan) kiya. Is qism (do objects ke qareeb aate hue) mein waves ki frequency aur amplitude dheere dheere barhte jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke 2015 ki pehli detection do takrate neutron stars se paida hone wali waves thin. Yeh ghalat hai: 14 September 2015 ko LIGO ne jo pehli gravitational waves pakrin woh do black holes ke milne (merger) se aayi thin, jaisa isi kitab ka topic 8.7 bhi kehta hai. Neutron stars ke takrao se waves pehli baar 2017 mein pakri gayin.

Gravitational waves ke context mein Binary System (BS) ka matlab aisa system hai jis mein do compact (bohat ghane) objects, jaise black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs, ek doosre ke gird ghoom rahe hon aur gravitational waves emit (kharij) kar rahe hon.
